rules:
Important Note:
The highlighted area is all called End of wicket i.e. exactly behind the stumps on both ends of the pitch.
Therefore, LED Sign at the Back of the Stumps (on both ends) should be categorized as LED Sign - End of Wicket Signage
LED sign on any other part of the stadium should be categoried as LED Sign
